counterfactual_p3star.two_aggregates_are_not_the_same_number: C-15's published net cost is a delta of OWN SCORES; the C-16 and P3* figures are deltas of MARGIN (own score minus opponent score). Over this panel they differ in sign: own score -24, opponent score -80, margin +56. Neither is wrong and neither may be quoted as the other.
counterfactual_p3star.what: eval_p3(True, candidate, parent) on the NON-eligible views -- the same whole-stream predicate applied where P3 does not reach. NOT a property violation and never reported as one.

gates.G-B eligible-class inertness: PASS -- 12/12 orchard-eligible views byte-identical to the parent
gates.G-C correspondence with the census: PASS -- the 28 non-eligible views the candidate changes are exactly the 28 games the census recorded an exchange on, decoded off the instrument arm's sw= wire by a different route
gates.G-M reproduction: PASS -- every view reproduces the recorded panel's candidate and parent margins
gates.G-P population identity: PASS -- 240 regenerated views agree with the recorded panel on map, seat, class and eligibility
gates.G-Q narration observed off: PASS -- on all 240 graded views the candidate's MSG fragments are identical to the parent's (the champion's one-time banner and nothing else); the arm emits no telemetry
gates.G-S subject identity: PASS -- arm-candidate.rs 5577cdce4789 matches the panel config and its sidecar, declares NARRATE_V5_ENABLED=false, and differs from arm-instrument.rs in exactly that one line
gates.G-V vacuity demonstration: PASS -- 28 non-eligible views have differing streams on which eval_p3(False, ...) returns [] while eval_p3(True, ...) returns a divergence; exit A is a guard, not a comparison

meaning: the candidate arm violates P3 0 times over 240 seat views. 228 of those views never reached a stream comparison at all -- eval_p3's orchard guard returned [] before looking -- and the remaining 12 are the eligible class, where the scoping makes the candidate byte-identical to the parent for the whole game by construction. So the bar is met and NO part of the zero comes from the candidate changing a stream and P3 finding it acceptable. Off-class, where P3 does not reach, the candidate changes 28 views.
not_proven_here: that the candidate is P3-neutral in any sense stronger than the scoping's whole-game inertness, or that the off-class changes are harmless -- P3* is a size, not a verdict, and the properties that do reach off-class (P1, P4, D-3) are graded by the panel and reported there, not here.
read: P3 on the candidate arm -- the bar, and how much of it is a measurement
